note: Pre-registered BEFORE Anping's round-2 verdicts. Predictions are hidden from the verdict page (blind test). Stars on his douban 1-5 scale. Scoring rule: |pred - actual| <= 0.5 = hit for seen shows; for unseen shows, appeal(想看) counts as directional support only, never a hit.

predictions.title: 流人 Slow Horses
predictions.rationale: GB crime-mystery zone is his strongest confirmed TV region (真相捕捉 x2 5星, 夏洛克 5星); tight 6-ep seasons, anti-glam, 智商在线, sardonic. All his confirmed virtues at once.

predictions.title: 切尔诺贝利 Chernobyl
predictions.rationale: Restrained, fact-forward, devastating without preaching; his 5-star words cluster on sincerity + weight (二十二, 小偷家族). 5 eps, zero filler.

predictions.title: 冰血暴 Fargo
predictions.rationale: He states love for 快节奏黑色幽默 (感谢你抽烟 5星); anthology crime with clean violence and irony. Risk: mid-season sag in some seasons keeps it at 4 not 5.

predictions.title: 心灵猎人 Mindhunter
predictions.rationale: Fincher is white-listed (avg 4.20); interview-room tension, precision, zero sentimentality. Risk: talky pacing vs his 拖沓 kill; Fincher discipline should carry it.

predictions.title: 熊家餐馆 The Bear
predictions.rationale: Food + craft sincerity (风味人间 5星) + relentless pacing. Risk: anxiety-drama register and S3 meandering; predicts 4 on S1-2 strength.
predictions.tests: food-craft transfer from docu to drama

predictions.title: 孤独的美食家
predictions.rationale: Purpose-built for his stated context (下饭剧, low load, episodic, real restaurants, sincere not 做作). Risk: could read as too slight to rate high even while watched happily.

predictions.title: 办公室(美版) The Office US
predictions.rationale: Deep US-sitcom loyalty collides head-on with his 尴尬 kill word: Michael Scott is embodied cringe. Deliberate boundary probe; genuinely uncertain.
predictions.tests: PROBE: cringe tolerance inside US sitcom safe zone

predictions.title: 南方公园 South Park
predictions.rationale: Adult animation staple + mocks every side including political correctness, which matches his stated resentment of preachiness. Crude art style irrelevant to him.

predictions.title: 黑道家族 The Sopranos
predictions.rationale: Prestige-crime writing peak (BCS all-5-star suggests transfer), but 90s-era pacing and therapy-session structure risk his 拖沓 kill. 4 with real downside risk.
predictions.tests: PROBE: canon prestige vs modern pacing standards

predictions.title: 兄弟连 Band of Brothers
predictions.rationale: 拯救大兵瑞恩 4星; 10 tight episodes, veteran interviews ground it in sincerity, no preach. War genre mildly positive for him (+0.14).

predictions.title: 伦敦生活 Fleabag
predictions.rationale: Tests whether his 英式喜剧欣赏不来 rule is about humiliation-cringe specifically or British comedy broadly. Fleabag is wit+sincerity, not cringe; if he likes it the rule refines. Predicting 3 = rule holds broadly.
predictions.tests: PROBE: refine the British-comedy red line

predictions.title: 葬送的芙莉莲 Frieren
predictions.rationale: Sincere, quiet, about time and farewell: his 5-star emotional cluster (来不及告别). But slow pastoral fantasy sits near his H9 治愈 skepticism and fantasy's -0.18. If he 5-stars it, sincerity beats pace; if 3, pace kills.
predictions.tests: PROBE: 慢但真 boundary in animation
